result.title: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
result.summary: Despite recent advances in CUAs, their development remains constrained by the limited diversity, controllability, and reliability of interaction data. Moreover, conventional optimization pipelines lack iterative feedback, while existing recursive improvement approaches often rely on self-generated experiences, limiting ability expansion and yielding diminishing returns. To address these challenges, we introduce CUA-Master, a nested double-loop recursive improvement framework. At the system level, an outer world-data-model flywheel continuously incorporates open-world corpus and leverages evolving model weaknesses to guide subsequent data construction and optimization iterations. At the data level, an inner flywheel couples open-world seeding and autocatalytic propagation. The former mines authentic workflows as seed tasks from instructional videos, and employs visual-semantic dual-path trajectory reconstruction; The latter transforms these seeds into reusable primitives for controllable synthesis of diverse, complex, and verifiable tasks. To enable efficient and reliable trajectory collection, we further introduce a feedback-guided snapshot-rollback retry mechanism in various real environments. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CUA-Master-27B achieves competitive performance across GUI-only and GUI-CLI hybrid benchmarks, scoring 80.2 on OSWorld Verified, 36.9 on OSWorld 2.0, 43.9 on WeaveBench, and 25.0 on Agents' Last Exam. Our framework also substantially improves the quality and efficiency of data synthesis, and exhibits continuous gains across recursive iterations.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CUA-Master 双层递归改进框架：外层以开放世界语料和模型弱点驱动数据构建与优化迭代，内层从教学视频挖掘真实工作流作为种子任务，经视觉-语义双路径重建轨迹并转化为可复用原语，可控合成可验证的复杂任务，再用反馈引导的快照回滚重试机制收集轨迹，训练出 27B 计算机使用智能体。
AI.relevance_reason: 其可验证任务合成与回滚重试的轨迹采集方式，可能为多步视觉推理轨迹的监督构造、失败归因与贡献分配提供可核查线索，但本身不涉及 latent 推理状态。
